rules.source: Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP/DSG, SR 235.1, revised, in force 1 Sept 2023) — applies to all personal-data processing with effects in Switzerland regardless of where the processing organization is based; protects natural persons only (unlike the prior 1992 law, which also covered legal entities). Data subjects have the right to information on data collection and to data portability. Official consolidated text: fedlex.admin.ch (SR 235.1).

FADP (SR 235.1) — introduces specific protection against high-risk automated profiling for Swiss nationals; enforcement by the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC), with penalties up to CHF 250,000 against the responsible natural person. Official consolidated text: fedlex.admin.ch (SR 235.1).

Bundesgesetz über den Datenschutz (DSG), SR 235.1, AS 2022 491, Art. 24 — https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/filestore/fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/2022/491/20250707/de/pdf-a/fedlex-data-admin-ch-eli-cc-2022-491-20250707-de-pdf-a.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Art. 24 Meldung von Verletzungen der Datensicherheit, Abs. 1: 'Der Verantwortliche meldet dem EDÖB so rasch als möglich eine Verletzung der Datensicherheit, die voraussichtlich zu einem hohen Risiko für die Persönlichkeit oder die Grundrechte der betroffenen Person führt.'

rules.source: Swiss Criminal Code (StGB), SR 311.0, Art. 143bis Unauthorised access to a data processing system (consolidated version of 1 Oct 2026, English, unofficial translation) — https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/filestore/fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/54/757_781_799/20261001/en/pdf-a/fedlex-data-admin-ch-eli-cc-54-757_781_799-20261001-en-pdf-a.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Art. 143bis para 1: obtaining unauthorised access by means of data transmission equipment to a data processing system specially secured against access is liable on complaint to a custodial sentence not exceeding three years or a monetary penalty; para 2 covers marketing or making accessible passwords/programs intended for that offence.

rules.source: Swiss Criminal Code (StGB), SR 311.0, Art. 261bis Discrimination and incitement to hatred (consolidated 1 Oct 2026, English, unofficial translation) — https://fedlex.data.admin.ch/filestore/fedlex.data.admin.ch/eli/cc/54/757_781_799/20261001/en/pdf-a/fedlex-data-admin-ch-eli-cc-54-757_781_799-20261001-en-pdf-a.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Art. 261bis: 'Any person who publicly incites hatred or discrimination against a person or a group of persons on the grounds of their race, ethnic origin, religion or sexual orientation' (and related acts of publicly denigrating or discriminating in a manner that violates human dignity) is liable under the article.
